segments.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
segments.text: Thanks for making time today. I'd love to hear how your team plans deliveries right now.

segments.speaker: Hannah Schmidt
segments.text: Mostly spreadsheets. Each depot lead builds routes the night before and emails them to drivers.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: And when a customer changes a delivery window, someone has to rebuild the route by hand.

segments.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
segments.text: That's exactly what Relay automates. Routes update live and drivers get the change in the app.

segments.speaker: Hannah Schmidt
segments.text: How does pricing work if we have seasonal peaks? Our volume doubles in November.

segments.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
segments.text: We have a per stop plan for exactly that. I'll send you a pricing comparison for both plans by Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: On the IT side we need single sign-on and an export to our warehouse system.

segments.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
segments.text: Both are supported. Tom, could you share your identity provider details so our engineers can check the setup?

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Sure, I'll send them over tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Hannah Schmidt
segments.text: If the numbers work, we'd want a pilot at two depots before the peak season.

segments.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
segments.text: Let's plan that. We need to agree on success criteria for the pilot before we start.
